products.name: Ideogram
products.note: Text-in-image generation; typography AI; commercial use; IP and copyright considerations

profile_text.body:
Ideogram describes itself as a generative media platform that brings together purpose-built creative apps, image and video model access, and API infrastructure in a single service. Its site states that one endpoint handles authentication, usage, and billing across supported image and video models, with users able to switch between models by changing the model string in a request.

The company's primary product, also called Ideogram, is focused on text-in-image generation and typography AI, with commercial use supported alongside noted IP and copyright considerations. Ideogram 4.0 is described on the site as an open model whose weights are available for local use and customization under an applicable license, while also remaining accessible through the platform itself.

The held facts record no litigation or MCP server presence, and the profile was verified as of August 2026.
